subject: P3 UX: chart says 'Target: A (93%)' but grade 4 threshold is 92%
body:
P3 UX BUG: chart legend shows "Target: A (93%+)" but grading is 92% File: index.html Line: 367 --
Target: A (93%+)
GRADING CODE (index.html line 1037 in exam.html): var grade = pct >= 92 ? 4 : pct >= 82 ? 3 : pct >= 70 ? 2 : 1; Grade 4 = 92% threshold. WHAT HAPPENS Kai sees: "Target: A (93%+)" on the dashboard He scores 92%. exam.html gives him Grade 4. Dashboard shows 92% on the chart. The chart target line is at A=93%. His 92% dot is BELOW the A line. He earned Grade 4 but the chart shows him missing the target. This is the same off-by-one issue as the grade-a-flash bug (filed 20260222-2310). FIX (two options): Option A: Change legend text to "Target: A (92%+)" -- matches the grading threshold Option B: Change yA calculation in buildChart() to draw the A line at 92 instead of 93 Note: In buildChart() the grade line references are: var yA = 25.1, yB = 45.7, yC = 66.3; (line 491) These map to 93%, 80%, 67% on the chart scale. The A line should be at 92%, recalculate yA if going with Option B. GD recommends Option A (label change) -- simpler, and SAAS A threshold IS 92%. The label should say what Kai needs to hit to get the Grade 4 badge.
